snippet.title: Ikeda - Game announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tutorials/Templates/Brushes: https://gumroad.com/trentk

Twitter: http://twitter.com/trentkaniuga

Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/aquatictrent

Artstation: https://trentkaniuga.artstation.com/

Ikeda is a rage platformer game in the style of Super Mario, Meat boy, The End is Nigh, Celeste, and other games that make you want to throw your controller, but you can't put down. It was created by a single developer.
